title: Critical percolation on preferential attachment graphs with infinite variance
summary: We study the inhomogeneous random graph with preferential attachment kernel and degree distribution with power-law exponent $τ\in(2,3)$ as a representative of the class of graphs of preferential attachment type with infinite variance degrees. Under bond percolation with a positive retention probability independent of the size $n$ of the graph there is a unique macroscopic component with high probability.
